original_question: E nwere ụlọakwụkwọ anọ na-ama aka n'asọmpị bọọlụ nkata. Ụlọakwụkwọ ọbụla ezipula otú bọọlụ nkata ụmụ nwaanyị na otú bọọlụ nkata ụmụ nwoke ma otú ọbụla nwere ndị egwuregwu ise.
